accepted_for_next_stage.formula_summary: During each Decode/Prefill overlap interval, charge only the average remaining fraction of the known profiled Prefill service. Keep the intrinsic overhead fully charged because its temporal placement is unknown.

rejected_general_guard.reason: On the 677-condition design-set back-check it reduced false acceptance only from 4 to 3 while increasing false rejection from 47 to 151 when paired with remaining-Prefill blocking.
rejected_general_guard.conclusion: Do not use a global TTFT reserve as the general safety fix.

mechanism_screen.population: h103 and h105 short workloads; 528 cached physical conditions
mechanism_screen.note: 0%, 2.5%, and 5% global TTFT reserves produced identical verdict counts on this short screening set; 10% caused more false rejections.

long_confirmation.population: h104 and h106 long workloads; 490 cached physical conditions
long_confirmation.conclusion: Remaining-Prefill blocking again reduces conservative rejections without introducing unsafe approvals, but it does not by itself fix the sampled capacity edge.

design_set_backcheck.population: 677 previously used diagnostic conditions; diagnostic only, not held-out
design_set_backcheck.conclusion: Remaining-Prefill blocking addresses the conservative TPOT side. The high-load TTFT unsafe approvals are a separate problem and are not solved by this blocking correction.

next_problem: Design a targeted high-load/profile-uncertainty safety guard that attacks TTFT unsafe approvals without globally sacrificing safe capacity.
